same_full_lp_representation: All methods use the same compact all-inequality formulation in d variables.
ours_learning: Unique-optimizer simplification: one compact full-LP solve per training sample, followed by an SVD of optimizer differences.
fcnn_baseline_scope: Cost-only FCNN-c adaptation with repeated epochs; not a bit-for-bit reproduction of Iwata and Sakaue.
timing_sd: sample SD across independent data seeds, not machine repeats
matched_reduced_dimension: For each case and data seed, both methods use K=max(1, Ours unpadded learned rank); the K=1 floor is disclosed with raw_learned_rank=0.
online_total_definition: neural forward + per-query reduced matrix/objective build + coordinate/row-scaling preparation + all HiGHS attempts
full_lp_online_definition: input preparation + one HiGHS call on the common d-variable formulation
